summary: Prepared and pushed a candidate real SolrCloud recovery test. It holds replica update requests with a targeted Jetty filter; uses a batch of large valid string fields to try to create backpressure; checks the actual stall IOException via the existing error hook, term eligibility, successful update response, recovery and each document version on leader and replica. Source review and staged diff --check only; not compiled or run on Windows. Backpressure, filter matching, stall timing, term and recovery assumptions are unverified. Linux must prove each and distinguish fixture failure from production behavior.
